description: This file defines the ContentPage class within the Todaymade\Daux\Format\HTML namespace. It manages rendering HTML content pages, including generating breadcrumbs, determining page type (home or landing), and preparing page data for templates in a documentation site generator.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering a content page in an HTML documentation generator, including breadcrumb creation, page metadata, and template selection.

methods.name: isHomepage
methods.description: Determines if the current page is the homepage by checking if it is the index page of its parent directory and if that parent is the root.

methods.name: isLanding
methods.description: Checks if the current page is the landing page based on configuration and homepage status.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the page, setting language and homepage status based on directory structure and configuration.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbTrail
methods.description: Generates an array representing the breadcrumb navigation trail based on parent directories, considering multilanguage settings.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Creates the data structure for rendering the page, including title, URL, breadcrumbs, and selecting the appropriate template.
